title: Business Development Executive
description:
Responsibilities Lead generation: Identify nursing homes, multi-specialty hospitals, and clinics in your territory and build a steady pipeline through field visits, referrals, medical associations, CMEs, and local networks. Lead validation: Qualify prospects on bed count, decision-makers, current documentation practices, budget, and readiness for digital adoption. Keep the CRM/tracker up to date. Product demos: Run in-person PurpleIPD demos for hospital owners, doctors, nursing heads, and administrators, tailored to their workflows and pain points. Follow-up and closure: Follow up consistently, handle objections, and work with the internal team on proposals and pricing. Market feedback: Share insights on competitors, customer needs, and feature requests. Targets: Meet monthly targets for visits, qualified leads, and demos.

Key Skills: Software,Lead generation,Hospital,Medical devices,Healthcare,Workflow,Sales,Medical
